messages.subject: User-defined objective function - Table of obj. func. each variable
messages.subject_clean: User-defined objective function - Table of obj. func. each variable
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

I am trying to implement my own objective function in order to take into consideration several criteria for the calibration. Therefore, I modified the userObjFunction.R file as explained in the tutorial <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JeiyWpvgAck>.

In the results, when I calculate the objective function, the table of objective function values seems correct. However, when I click on "Display table of obj. func. each variable" the displayed values do not correspond to the ones of the table of objective function values. It seems that only the values of the first criteria (put in output$perCriteria[[1]] in the userObjFunction.R file) are displayed.

I mean, when I select NSE as objective function, by clicking on "Display table of obj. func. each variable" I get the values for other criteria: KGE, aBIAS, RMSE and R2. In the case of user defined, it only shows one criteria, and it seems to be the one put in output$perCriteria[[1]]. How can I do to have all the criteria calculated and displayed  ?

I put the userObjFunction.R file so that you can understand what I am trying to do.

Thank you in advance for your help !

Mathilde Puche

messages.subject: Re: standard deviation error
messages.body_plain:
Hi, these error will not affect the model results

1. [SPS-WARNING] 2023-04-03 07:59:34 the standard deviation is zero: This could be because the standard deviation of either observed or simulated results is zero, and the correlation cannot be calculated, in this case NA will be return. When calculate the objective function I always calculate the KGE, NSE, BIAS regardless of the users setting, in this case KGE require the correlation, as standard deviation is zero, KGE value will be NA

2. Using `size` aesthetic for lines was deprecated in ggplot2 3.4.0.: only affect display

messages.subject_clean: SWATShiny App GUI disappears After Windows 10 goes into sleep mode
messages.body_plain:
Dear Tam,
I am grateful to you and the other developers for creating this app. I recently observed that SWATShiny app GUI (both version 2.2 and the latest version) disappears when Windows 10 goes into 'sleep mode '. Even though, the Shiny App disappears, the model continues to run. This is seen when I constantly check the  'CurrentSimulationReport.txt' in the Output folder found in the workingFolder.
My questions are :
1. How do I bring up the GUI interface without stopping the process in the R Console?
2. Does R-SWAT save my previous run automatically after I have run an iteration for a number of simulations?

Thank you

Best regards
Peter Odoom

messages.subject: Re: Replacing best parameters in SWAT+
messages.body_plain:
Please see section 3.8. Read_User_Parameter_File  in this documentation

https://github.com/tamnva/R-SWAT/wiki/R-SWAT-User-Manual#38-read_user_parameter_file

Here you just run again with the best parameter set and a TxtInOut folder in the working folder will be created with the best parameter values

Hello Abu Zafor, look in your channel_sd_***.txt file and look for the reach number you want to calibrate in the column "name", see if the number in the column  "unit" is the same, if they are not the same, use the number in the unit column in rswat and do the test. In my case the numbers were cha0402 (column name) and 335 (column unit), so I managed to extract the data correctly.
Hope it works.
